question: What is the name of Mahatma Gandhi’s autobiography?

options.text: The Story of My Experiments with Truth

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Story of My Experiments with Truth.**__

• **Mahatma Gandhi **is commonly considered the father of the nation India.

 
 
• He was born on 2 October 1869.
 
• He went to South Africa to practice law in 1893.
 
• He started Phoenix settlement at Durban.
 
• Started Tolstoy farm at Johannesbur
